text: Lisgar Street residents have contacted my office regarding a lack of parking on their street. Residents suggested affixing parking to the west side of the Lisgar Street, between Dundas Street West and Afton Avenue, between December 1st and March 31st instead of on the east side of the street. Residents claimed that this switch would provide more parking during the winter months for residents. I brought this matter to the attention of Permit Parking staff, who confirmed that there will in fact be an additional 5 parking spaces, should parking be affixed to the west side of the street during the winter months. This change proposed in this motion will alleviate parking pressures made challenging by snow.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from the 16th day to the last day of each month from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, on the east side of Lisgar Street, between Afton Avenue and Dundas Street West. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from December 1 of one year to March 31 of the next following year, inclusive, and from the 1st day to the 15th day of each month from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, on the west side of Lisgar Street, between Afton Avenue and Dundas Street West. 3. Prohibited parking at all times on the east side of Lisgar Street, between Afton Avenue and Dundas Street West. 4.
